scope: Close a workspace lifecycle coverage gap: deleting a selected local workspace profile must be reversible and must never call Page Model Save or Publish.

finding.initial_hypothesis: Profile deletion and its local Undo/Redo lifecycle were not directly covered in Chromium, despite neighboring profile create/load/import tests.
finding.observed_behavior: A selected profile can be deleted, its selector clears, Undo restores the exact profile ID, and Redo removes that same ID again. No Page Model Save or Publish request occurs.

assertions: selected-profile deletion persists only the remaining profile ID
deletion clears the selector when the selected profile no longer exists
Undo restores the deleted profile with the same ID
Redo removes that same profile ID again
no Page Model Save or Publish request
